title: Ember Hand
brief: Turn-based card tactics on a 5x5 grid. Drag a card from your hand onto a tile to play it; playing a card spends mana and damages the enemy before the enemy replies. A run is seeded, so a given seed must deal the same opening hand. In GameState keep mana, cards_played, turn, enemy_hp and won; reduce enemy_hp to zero to set won.
artDirection: Parchment-and-ember card frames, readable hand at the bottom, a lit 5x5 board, high-contrast enemy portraits.

obligations.description: Dragging a card onto a legal tile plays it and raises cards_played.
Playing a card lowers mana from its starting three.
A damage card lowers enemy_hp from its starting ten.
Dropping the enemy to zero hp wins the battle.
The enemy replies only after the played card has resolved.
obligations.unsupported: Turn order is a relationship between two changes; the vocabulary reads one property at a time and has no ordered checkpoints between them.

obligations.description: Seed 7 deals the same opening hand on every run.
obligations.unsupported: Card identity is a string and the probe's expect forms only read numeric thresholds and changes; repeatability of a deal also needs two runs compared at the same seed.

obligations.description: Dragging a card onto a tile plays it while dropping it elsewhere cancels.
obligations.unsupported: The route format has press, hold and wait only; drag and targeted pointer input do not exist, so the play gesture itself cannot be observed or distinguished from a cancel.
